question: Juniper Networks founded location headquarters

Juniper Networks, founded in February 1996 in Mountain View, California, is headquartered at 1133 Innovation Way, Sunnyvale, California. It was founded by Pradeep Sindhu and is now a subsidiary of Hewlett Packard Enterprise. The company has development offices in China and India.
